description: Look up anime opening and ending themes on AnimeThemes, the community archive of OP/ED videos. Search the catalogue, browse anime by year, season, format or studio, follow an artist through every song they performed, and get direct streaming links to the WebM video and OGG audio of any theme. Also reads public playlists, the featured theme of the day, and the site's own documentation pages. No account or API key required.
